# CommandLineError

Why the arguments did not match the command.

```rux
pub variant CommandLineError {
    UnknownOption(OsStringView),
    MissingValue(char8[..]),
    UnexpectedValue(char8[..]),
    UnknownCommand(OsStringView),
    MissingCommand,
    MissingPositional(char8[..]),
    UnexpectedArgument(OsStringView),
    InvalidValue(char8[..], OsStringView)
}
```

Failure-only: a parse is the success channel of `Parsed ! CommandLineError`. Copy; every view and name it carries
borrows the arguments or the specification, which must outlive it.

## Cases

| Name                                    | Description                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `UnknownOption(OsStringView)`           | An argument that looks like an option names none the command has. Carries the argument as typed.                                            |
| `MissingValue(char8[..])`               | An option that takes a value was the last argument, or ended a cluster of short options. Carries the option's long name.                    |
| `UnexpectedValue(char8[..])`            | A flag was given a value with `=`. Carries the option's long name.                                                                          |
| `UnknownCommand(OsStringView)`          | The command has subcommands and the word naming one is not among them. Carries the word as typed.                                           |
| `MissingCommand`                        | The command has subcommands and none was named.                                                                                             |
| `MissingPositional(char8[..])`          | A required positional argument was not given. Carries its name.                                                                             |
| `UnexpectedArgument(OsStringView)`      | A positional argument beyond every one the command accepts. Carries the argument as typed.                                                  |
| `InvalidValue(char8[..], OsStringView)` | A value that could not be read as what was asked of it, such as a number. Carries the option or positional's name, then the value as typed. |

## Implements Display

`CommandLineError` conforms to `Display`.

<h3 id="write-display"><code>WriteDisplay</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WriteDisplay(
    self: &CommandLineError,
    writer: &var TextWriter,
    spec: FormatSpec
) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes what went wrong, naming the argument, option or positional involved.
The text is lower case without a final full stop, such as `unknown option '--frob'` or
`option '--output' needs a value`. No style is understood. Reports whatever the writer reported, and
`UnsupportedRequest` for a style.

| Name     | Type              | Description                    |
| -------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `writer` | `&var TextWriter` | the destination                |
| `spec`   | `FormatSpec`      | what the placeholder asked for |

**Returns**: success when the whole description was accepted

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/CommandLine/Src/Error.rux#L108)

## Implements Debug

`CommandLineError` conforms to `Debug`.

<h3 id="write-debug"><code>WriteDebug</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WriteDebug(
    self: &CommandLineError,
    writer: &var TextWriter,
    spec: FormatSpec
) -> ! FormatError
```

The same text as `Display`: the description already names everything involved.
